query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM email_outbox
                    WHERE user_id = $1 AND purpose = $2
                      AND created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => $3)
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT 1 FROM email_tokens
                    WHERE user_id = $1 AND purpose = $2
                      AND created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => $3)
                ) AS "recent!"
